ABOUT ME

Immediate Joiner Senior Business Analyst with 11+ years of experience delivering Banking, Healthcare SaaS, and Digital Experience Platform solutions. Expertise in Agile Delivery, Product Backlog Management, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, Stakeholder Management, CMS Platforms including Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), Sitecore, and Contentstack, API Integrations, UAT, and Digital Transformation initiatives.

SKILLS

Requirements Elicitation • Stakeholder Management • Product Analysis • Product Backlog Management Stories • Acceptance Criteria • Agile Scrum • Sprint Planning • Backlog Reﬁnement Speciﬁcations • BRD • FRD • Business Process Analysis Customer Journey Mapping Management REST APIs • JSON • Postman • Microsoft Dynamics CRM • Sitecore CMS DevOps • MS Visio • SDLC AEM and Content Stack

API Integration •

Netsmart EMR • Jira • Conﬂuence • Azure

WORK EXPERIENCE

SENIOR BUSINESS ANALYST – FINT SOLUTIONS – 07/26/2023 – 04/24/2026

Banking | Microsoft Dynamics CRM | Customer Onboarding & Card Activation Platform

Led the end-to-end implementation of Microsoft Dynamics CRM supporting customer onboarding, KYC veriﬁcation, card activation, OTP authentication, customer servicing, and case management workﬂows.

Conducted stakeholder workshops and translated business requirements into Epics, Features, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, Functional Speciﬁcations, Process Flows, and Wireframes.

Collaborated with Product Managers, Developers, QA teams, and Operations teams to drive backlog prioritization, sprint planning, UAT, SIT, and release deployment.

Deﬁned API integrations and data ﬂows between CRM, authentication services, KYC platforms, and banking applications.

Improved card activation eﬃciency by 30%, generating $20K annual savings, while facilitating 40+ stakeholder workshops.

PRODUCT ANALYST 2 – PHOTON INFOTECH – 06/28/2021 – 03/03/2023

Digital Experience Platforms | AEM | Sitecore | Contentstack

Led business analysis and Agile delivery initiatives for enterprise digital experience platforms leveraging Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), Sitecore CMS, and Contentstack CMS.

Partnered with Product Managers, UX/UI teams, Developers, QA teams, and business stakeholders to deﬁne requirements and deliver customer-facing digital experiences.

Gathered and analyzed business requirements and translated them into User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, Functional Speciﬁcations, Process Flows, Wireframes, and Backlog Items.

Collaborated with content authors, development teams, and platform administrators to support content management, workﬂow automation, personalization, and publishing capabilities.

Facilitated backlog grooming, sprint planning, sprint reviews, UAT, defect management, and release planning activities.

Conducted customer journey analysis and digital experience optimization initiatives that reduced cart abandonment by 30% and contributed approximately $50K in additional revenue.

Supported API integrations and coordination across CMS platforms, business applications, and third-party services.

SENIOR BUSINESS AND QUALITY ANALYST – SUTHERLAND HEALTHCARE SOLUTIONS – 12/09/2015 – 11/11/2019

Healthcare SaaS | Netsmart EMR | Clinical & Revenue Cycle Management

Led the implementation of the Netsmart EMR SaaS platform, supporting patient registration, provider management, clinical documentation, billing, claims processing, and healthcare operations.

• Collaborated with healthcare stakeholders, business users, and technology teams to gather requirements and

deﬁne future-state workﬂows for clinical and operational processes.

• Authored BRDs, FRDs, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, Functional Speciﬁcations, Process Maps, and Workﬂow

Diagrams.

• Supported SaaS product enhancements, release management, SIT, UAT, defect triage, requirements traceability,

and production deployments.

Partnered with cross-functional teams to improve healthcare workﬂows, data quality, user adoption, and operational eﬃciency.

Reduced production defects by 25% through improved testing governance and requirement validation.

BUSINESS ANALYST – AJUBA SOLUTIONS – 05/03/2012 – 07/13/2015

Banking and Healthcare Operations

Gathered and documented business requirements, process workﬂows, functional speciﬁcations, and testing scenarios for enterprise healthcare applications.

Supported UAT, defect management, production validation, and continuous process improvement initiatives.

KEY ACHIEVEMENTS

ACHIEVEMENTS

Led Microsoft Dynamics CRM implementation initiatives improving operational eﬃciency by 30% and generating $20K annual savings.

Facilitated 40+ stakeholder workshops, successfully translating business needs into Agile delivery outcomes. • Reduced cart abandonment by 30%, contributing approximately $50K in revenue growth through customer journey optimization.

Reduced production defects by 25% through improved requirements validation, testing governance, and stakeholder collaboration.

Successfully delivered enterprise Banking, Healthcare, and Digital Product transformation initiatives.

CERTIFICATIONS

Simplilearn, 09/03/2025 Certiﬁed Business Analysis Professional( CBAP)

Mode of learning: Online

EDUCATION AND TRAINING

06/01/2009 – 04/10/2012 BACHELOR OF COMPUTER APPLICATION Sri Chandrasekharendra Saraswathi Viswa Mahavidyalaya (SCSVMV)

sections.label: Experience
sections.text:
WORK EXPERIENCE
SENIOR BUSINESS ANALYST – FINT SOLUTIONS – 07/26/2023 – 04/24/2026
Banking | Microsoft Dynamics CRM | Customer Onboarding & Card Activation Platform
Led the end-to-end implementation of Microsoft Dynamics CRM supporting customer onboarding, KYC veriﬁcation, card activation, OTP authentication, customer servicing, and case management workﬂows.
Conducted stakeholder workshops and translated business requirements into Epics, Features, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, Functional Speciﬁcations, Process Flows, and Wireframes.
Collaborated with Product Managers, Developers, QA teams, and Operations teams to drive backlog prioritization, sprint planning, UAT, SIT, and release deployment.
Deﬁned API integrations and data ﬂows between CRM, authentication services, KYC platforms, and banking applications.
Improved card activation eﬃciency by 30%, generating $20K annual savings, while facilitating 40+ stakeholder workshops.
PRODUCT ANALYST 2 – PHOTON INFOTECH – 06/28/2021 – 03/03/2023
Digital Experience Platforms | AEM | Sitecore | Contentstack
Led business analysis and Agile delivery initiatives for enterprise digital experience platforms leveraging Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), Sitecore CMS, and Contentstack CMS.
Partnered with Product Managers, UX/UI teams, Developers, QA teams, and business stakeholders to deﬁne requirements and deliver customer-facing digital experiences.
Gathered and analyzed business requirements and translated them into User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, Functional Speciﬁcations, Process Flows, Wireframes, and Backlog Items.
Collaborated with content authors, development teams, and platform administrators to support content management, workﬂow automation, personalization, and publishing capabilities.
Facilitated backlog grooming, sprint planning, sprint reviews, UAT, defect management, and release planning activities.
Conducted customer journey analysis and digital experience optimization initiatives that reduced cart abandonment by 30% and contributed approximately $50K in additional revenue.
Supported API integrations and coordination across CMS platforms, business applications, and third-party services.
SENIOR BUSINESS AND QUALITY ANALYST – SUTHERLAND HEALTHCARE SOLUTIONS – 12/09/2015 – 11/11/2019
Healthcare SaaS | Netsmart EMR | Clinical & Revenue Cycle Management
Led the implementation of the Netsmart EMR SaaS platform, supporting patient registration, provider management, clinical documentation, billing, claims processing, and healthcare operations.
• Collaborated with healthcare stakeholders, business users, and technology teams to gather requirements and
deﬁne future-state workﬂows for clinical and operational processes.
• Authored BRDs, FRDs, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, Functional Speciﬁcations, Process Maps, and Workﬂow
Diagrams.
• Supported SaaS product enhancements, release management, SIT, UAT, defect triage, requirements traceability,
and production deployments.
Partnered with cross-functional teams to improve healthcare workﬂows, data quality, user adoption, and operational eﬃciency.
Reduced production defects by 25% through improved testing governance and requirement validation.
BUSINESS ANALYST – AJUBA SOLUTIONS – 05/03/2012 – 07/13/2015
Banking and Healthcare Operations
Gathered and documented business requirements, process workﬂows, functional speciﬁcations, and testing scenarios for enterprise healthcare applications.
Supported UAT, defect management, production validation, and continuous process improvement initiatives.
KEY ACHIEVEMENTS
